card.name: Month names in day-month-year dates
card.fires_on: The month name (or its start or abbreviation) right after a day number in a written date, such as 23 May 2013. Mostly in citations, web access dates and timestamps.

modes.description: A short month like Feb, Jun or Aug follows a day number in a reference or timestamp.
